Q0570

“The Law has obliged us to reflect upon existing things by means…” — Averroes (Q0570)

An English quotation associated with The Decisive Treatise, opening (Butterworth), organized here under reason.

Quotes / Averroes / Q0570

English

The Law has obliged us to reflect upon existing things by means of the intellect, and to seek knowledge of them from that perspective.
Thinker Averroes
School Islamic Philosophy
Source The Decisive Treatise, opening (Butterworth)
Theme Reason
Another quotation More from this thinker

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with The Decisive Treatise, opening (Butterworth), within the Islamic Philosophy tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of reason, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Averroes's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
